summary: Planned signature public space of the Power Station around the 300-foot Stack: an accessible civic space for arrival, gathering and appreciating the Stack, which may also hold a bar or café within it and room for temporary events, performances and art exhibits (Design for Development Section 4.21). SF Planning lists it at about 0.6 acre.

facts.value: D4D 4.21.2 puts a pedestrian throughway at the southern edge of Stack Plaza and 'along the southern edge of Block 9 with Unit 3'; 4.21.10 suggests a visual buffer 'along the southern edge of the site, between Stack Plaza and the eastern Spreckels Warehouse'

sources.title: Potrero Power Station Design for Development (final, dated February 26, 2020)
sources.publisher: SF Planning (hosts the D4D; the D4D names no author)

sources.title: Potrero Power Station project page (program elements, approval timeline, implementation milestones)
sources.note: The page shows no publication or update date. Read 2026-10-13; no date recorded.

open_questions: No source read gives a construction date for Stack Plaza.

The shape on the map is built from Assessor lot 4175028, Block 9's south edge and neighbouring shapes, not traced from the Design for Development's drawing of the plaza (Figure 4.21.2), so its outline may differ by tens of metres; at about 0.45 acre it is smaller than the 0.6 acre SF Planning lists.
The plaza was previously named only inside the Waterfront Park record.
